worldWidth.description: Width of the simulation world in pixels.

worldHeight.description: Height of the simulation world in pixels.

redDetectionRange.description: Radius within which Red actors can detect Blue actors. UI: Detection Range

redAttackRange.description: Distance at which Red triggers combat with Blue. UI: Attack Range

redAggression.description: Multiplier for how strongly Red chases detected Blue. UI: Aggression

blueFlockVision.description: Radius within which Blue actors see friends for flocking. UI: Flock Vision

bluePersonalSpace.description: Minimum distance Blue tries to keep from other Blue. UI: Personal Space

blueDefenseRange.description: Range to count nearby Blue defenders during combat. UI: Defense Range

blueCohesion.description: Strength of Cohesion (moving towards neighbor center). UI: Cohesion

blueSeparation.description: Strength of Separation (avoiding crowding neighbors). UI: Separation

blueAlignment.description: Strength of Alignment (matching neighbor velocities). UI: Alignment

blueEdgeAvoidance.description: Strength of turning away from screen edges. UI: Edge Avoidance

maxSpeed.description: Maximum speed an actor can travel per tick.

minSpeed.description: Minimum speed Blue actors try to maintain.

displayDetectionCircle.description: Toggle drawing of detection radius for Red actors.

displayDefenseCircle.description: Toggle drawing of defense radius for Blue actors.
